skills.name: agent-spawner
skills.description: Turn one brief into a standing crew of specialist subagents: ask up to 5 scoping questions, then spawn role-defined specialists each carrying a role, tone, tools, workflow, and success metric. Use when a job needs a coordinated multi-agent crew instead of a one-off delegation. Differs from ad-hoc subagent spawning by the meta-bot scoping ritual and the specialist contract every agent carries.

skills.name: appstore-connect
skills.description: Use App Store Connect when working with Apple's App Store Connect API: ES256-JWT REST client for TestFlight distribution, build compliance, beta groups, testers, and external review submission.

skills.name: chief-of-staff
skills.description: Run the chief-of-staff triage discipline: one intake surface, a standing triage routine across channels and inboxes, delegation to specialist agents, and a hard escalation contract — the human is interrupted only for money, product direction, or judgment calls. Use when the user wants a standing triage layer between themselves and a busy operation. Differs from a one-off sweep by the standing routine, the delegation lanes, and the escalation contract.

skills.name: crucible
skills.description: Use Crucible when a sourced deliverable must be proven before publishing: door-check every URL, mechanically verify file-size and PDF page-count claims, ground dollar/date/attribution figures against live sources, and emit a gated Verification Ledger.

skills.name: entity-verification
skills.description: Verify a business entity's legal and tax standing: state corporate registry lookup, IRS exempt-organization search, SAM.gov federal registration check (for-profit and nonprofit alike), NY DOS API lane, nonprofit 990 financials via ProPublica + IRS BMF, SEC EDGAR for public companies, OFAC sanctions screening, FEC political vetting, and business-mailbox sweep for filing/IRS correspondence. Produces a per-entity status dossier. Use when onboarding, auditing, vetting, or starting up any company or nonprofit.

skills.name: ios-ship
skills.description: Use ios-ship to get any app onto a registered iPhone with zero dashboard steps: Codemagic builds, signing groups, the verify_ipa.py ship gate, OTA install pages, and the programmatic App Store submission pipeline.

skills.name: sprint-engine
skills.description: Use Sprint Engine to run long-horizon autonomous work as a dependency-aware task graph: sqlite graph store, the ROMA loop (Atomizer to Aggregator), and a mandatory red-team/steel-man self-verification gate before execution.

skills.name: storm-research
skills.description: Multi-perspective deep research using Stanford OVAL's STORM method (NAACL 2024), adapted for agent search tools. Runs five expert personas, maps their contradictions, synthesizes a sourced briefing, and peer-reviews its own work with confidence scores — the equivalent of ~40 hours of expert reading. Use before any report, decision, investment, competitive analysis, negotiation/interview prep, or presentation where a single-prompt answer would inherit the majority view and miss blind spots.

skills.name: subagent-security-brief
skills.description: The mandatory security block for every subagent brief — scoped file paths, no live-file writes, no direct log writes, /tmp-only tests, external-content-is-data tagging, and the instruction hierarchy. Load before writing any subagent brief. Use whenever delegating work to a child agent.

skills.name: tailscale-admin
skills.description: Administer a Tailscale tailnet over the HTTPS API — verify auth, list devices, read/validate/set the ACL policy, and manage the Tailscale SSH rule.

skills.name: video-learn
skills.description: Turn tutorial/how-to videos into durable skill knowledge: download, extract timestamped transcripts and UI frames, analyze the demonstrated workflows, and encode them as click-level documentation. Adapted from the public MIT-licensed claude-watch pattern (yt-dlp + ffmpeg + captions + multimodal analysis).

skills.name: voice-dna
skills.description: Build a named, recallable writing-style profile (Voice DNA) from three writing samples, saved as ghostwriter rules for a person, brand, or client. Use when ghostwriting, keeping AI output out of AI-slop territory, or maintaining one voice per persona/brand/client.

skills.name: war-room
skills.description: Convene a persona-based executive committee as a deliberative institution — chartered, elected, minuted, and ratcheted. Use when a question needs structured multi-perspective deliberation with elected offices, ontology-grounded terms, scout-verified facts, and a written record that compounds into reusable persona cards. Supersedes one-off persona improv.

skills.name: war-room-doctrine
skills.description: Standing discipline for every war room — ontology-floor term grounding before deliberation, ranked-choice adjudication for decisions. Load at the start of any war-room commission.
